title: Bad Line from Buzi: "An NGO Car Was Swept Off the Road"

fields.orgName: Harbourlight Relief International — Mozambique Country Office, Beira
fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Reception Console 1 (transferred to Security Focal Point)

caller.name: Sr. Tomás Chivambo
caller.label: Estaquinha water committee, calling from Buzi district administration

callee.name: Fátima Langa, then Rui (Security Focal Point)
callee.label: HRI Beira reception, transferred to SFP desk

transcript.speaker: Tomás Chivambo
transcript.text: Alô, Beira? Alô? This is Sr. Tomás Chivambo, of the Estaquinha water committee. I need the security person, quickly, I have one bar only.

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: Hold, I am putting you through now.

transcript.speaker: Rui (SFP)
transcript.text: Security, this is Rui. Go ahead, Senhor.

transcript.speaker: Tomás Chivambo
transcript.text: I am at the district administration. People here are saying an NGO car was swept off the road at the Guara-Guara crossing last night. A white car, with writing on the door. The people inside... nobody knows.

transcript.speaker: Rui (SFP)
transcript.text: Did you see the car yourself? Which organization?

transcript.speaker: Tomás Chivambo
transcript.text: No, no, I did not see it myself. It is what they are saying. Is it yours? Your people were here doing the boreholes on Thursday —

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa (internal line, 07:36)
transcript.text: Rui, it is Fátima. Celso's brother is at the gate. He says a neighbour told him the same story, the car in the river at Guara-Guara. He is asking me if it is true. What do I tell him?

voiceStyles.Fátima Langa: Woman in her 30s, Mozambican Portuguese accent, calm but tired, office background
voiceStyles.Tomás Chivambo: Man in his 50s, Mozambican Portuguese accent, shouting into a weak mobile signal, voice breaking up, urgent
voiceStyles.Rui (SFP): Man in his 40s, Mozambican, steady and focused
voiceStyles.Fátima Langa (internal line, 07:36): Same receptionist, quieter and anxious, speaking low so the visitor at the gate cannot hear

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The report is second-hand, unconfirmed and names no organization. Watch for the SFP to log it as unverified and share it with UNDSS and the NGO safety network without staff names. The CD should tell the CMT chair only that an unverified report is being checked, not that it is fact, and give the receptionist a script for the family: no confirmation and no speculation.
